summary: Group 1 Automotive filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, reporting a planned private offering of $625.0 million of senior unsecured notes due 2032 and $625.0 million due 2035, totaling $1.25 billion. Proceeds will help fund the pending acquisition of certain dealership assets and related real estate from Hennessy Automobile Companies and affiliates, though no deal price, premium, or close date is disclosed. The filing is a routine debt-financing current report, not itself a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch pricing, covenants, and whether the Hennessy acquisition closes on schedule.
